new_destinations.name: ʻEua
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'ʻEua' and Tonga Tourism lists it at tongatourism.travel/our-islands/eua as one of Tonga's islands; travellers go to ʻEua as a hiking island (Pocket Guide: 5 best hikes in ʻEua).
new_destinations.why_not_park: ʻEua National Park is 4.5 km2 inside an 87 km2 island, and its kept neighbours (Rock Gardens, caves, beaches) lie outside it, so the island is the region travellers name and the park is a spot. Overlaps no existing destination (none in Tonga yet).
